audit_scope.limitation: Dependencies have been traced in source code and documentation. Concrete real-product dataset shapes/attributes have not yet been inventoried because the uploaded archives contain no .h5/.hdf5 source products.

retention_principles: Never AOI-crop a source grid before data retention: current GUNW reference selection and GOFF auto-reference/deramp use spatial pixels outside the AOI.
Never round, resample, cast to lower precision, or mask away source values in the retained scientific arrays.
Preserve exact dataset path, dtype, shape, values, coordinates, projection/CRS, units, ordinary attributes, full granule identity, source checksum and extraction software version.

Default archive retains every source dataset regardless of rank except multidimensional GUNW wrappedInterferogram raster datasets; a float wrappedPhase (radians) derivative is generated in bounded-memory chunks and verified. --include-wrapped retains the exact original complex samples as well.

Retain all GOFF pixelOffsets arrays for all available layers and polarizations, all GUNW unwrappedInterferogram arrays, all GUNW pixelOffsets arrays, all metadata/radarGrid arrays, and all other auxiliary multidimensional arrays.
Do not delete source until local archive verification, durable cloud upload, remote byte-size/checksum verification, and scientific-reader equivalence gates all pass.
Unknown future algorithms may require wrapped-interferogram grids; use --include-wrapped and measure actual storage before any deletion if complete source dataset retention is required.

Preserve and verify dataset maxshape and fillvalue; inventory original chunks/compression/filter settings. Physical chunking/compression may be changed only losslessly for size, with originals recorded in manifest.

GUNW.product_role: Geocoded unwrapped interferogram; core phase LOS measurement and quality masks

required_dataset_patterns.retention: full native array; all available frequency/polarization groups
required_dataset_patterns.why: Primary phase measurement; converted using d_los = -(wavelength/(4*pi))*phase.

required_dataset_patterns.pattern: same unwrappedInterferogram grid/group: coherenceMagnitude (or coherence), same-shape datasets
used_by: src/gunw_reader.py: coherence threshold, reference selection and quality stats
required_dataset_patterns.why: Pixel quality thresholding, common-reference candidate selection, local floors and output coherence band.
Rejects invalid phase/unwrapping components and prevents referencing across component offsets.

required_dataset_patterns.pattern: same unwrappedInterferogram grid/group: mask or layoverShadowMask
required_dataset_patterns.why: Decodes reference/secondary subswath validity and water flags; removing it changes the valid-pixel mask.

required_dataset_patterns.pattern: same unwrappedInterferogram grid/group: ionospherePhaseScreen and any co-gridded uncertainty arrays
required_dataset_patterns.retention: all co-gridded arrays, full native precision
used_by: src/gunw_reader.py: optional ionosphere correction and diagnostics
required_dataset_patterns.why: Current reader subtracts the phase screen by default when present; uncertainty is useful for future QA even if not used by the old reader.

required_dataset_patterns.retention: all arrays; preserve coordinate datasets and projection metadata
required_dataset_patterns.why: Full x/y axes, projection, losUnitVectorX, losUnitVectorY and incidenceAngle are sampled to get real look geometry at arbitrary target points.

required_dataset_patterns.pattern: */identification/lookDirection; centerFrequency/center_frequency/radarCenterFrequency; all scalar/1-D datasets; all root/group/dataset attributes
required_dataset_patterns.retention: preserve exact values and ordinary attributes
required_dataset_patterns.why: Look direction, wavelength, axis definitions, CRS/EPSG, measurement units, product maturity and schema provenance.

required_dataset_patterns.pattern: all datasets under */pixelOffsets/* in GUNW, for all layers/polarisations
used_by: Current gunw_reader product-layout documentation identifies this same-posting grid in GUNW products; retained for future same-granule GUNW/GOFF comparison and independent quality/cross-check analyses
required_dataset_patterns.why: The current displacement path does not read GUNW pixelOffsets directly, but dropping them would prevent later cross-checks without reacquiring the original granule; these arrays use the pixelOffsets grid rather than the higher-resolution wrapped-interferogram grid.

explicit_exclusion_default.reason: Current main-engine executable paths do not read the high-posting wrapped complex raster. Compact mode retains a verified phase-only sibling dataset named wrappedPhase (radians), plus coherence, offsets and coordinate vectors.
explicit_exclusion_default.future_risk: The phase-only derivative supports phase-domain diagnostics and future experiments, but discards complex amplitude and does not spatially unwrap phase. Algorithms needing exact original complex samples must use include_wrapped=true.
explicit_exclusion_default.derived_output: Sibling wrappedPhase dataset; chunked numpy.angle; radians; same native shape and coordinate dimension-scale attachments; output hash and source hash are recorded and verified.
explicit_exclusion_default.opt_in: tools/sarguardian_hdf5_archive.py archive --include-wrapped; workflow input include_wrapped=true explicitly includes this large raster.
explicit_exclusion_default.measurement_required: Real-product schema, storage delta, integrity and raw-vs-curated science-equivalence tests required before production deletion.
explicit_exclusion_default.cli_default: excluded unless --include-wrapped is passed to the archive tool
explicit_exclusion_default.pilot_workflow_default: excluded (include_wrapped=false) to avoid source-sized uploads; set true only if future wrapped-phase methods require it and storage permits

GOFF.product_role: Geocoded pixel offsets for coarser-window high-motion measurement and noise floor

required_dataset_patterns.retention: full native arrays for every present layer and polarization
required_dataset_patterns.why: Primary range/LOS measurement; never keep only the AOI median.

required_dataset_patterns.retention: full native arrays for every present layer and polarization
required_dataset_patterns.why: Across-track/along-flight displacement component; current report says it is kept for future component analysis.

required_dataset_patterns.retention: full native arrays for every present layer and polarization

required_dataset_patterns.pattern: */pixelOffsets/*/layer*/slantRangeOffsetVariance, alongTrackOffsetVariance, and all other co-gridded datasets
required_dataset_patterns.retention: full arrays; include datasets not used by the current reader if under pixelOffsets
used_by: future uncertainty propagation and alternative estimators
required_dataset_patterns.why: Current reader uses slant-range variance when available; it currently does not use along-track variance, but discarding it would close off plausible future uncertainty analyses.

required_dataset_patterns.pattern: all xCoordinates, yCoordinates, projection datasets and projection attributes; all scalar/1-D datasets; all root/group/dataset attributes
used_by: src/goff_reader.py: AOI masking, raster transform, spatial export
required_dataset_patterns.why: Spatial location, CRS/EPSG, axis values, units and provenance.

GOFF.critical_scope_rule: Keep full selected pixelOffsets grids, not only AOI pixels: auto-reference and deramp fit stable areas outside the AOI and require >5000 fitting pixels in the current implementation.

post_archive_validation_gates: Inventory the real product schema (every dataset path, shape, dtype, units, attrs, chunking and source hash) before enabling any deletion.
Build the curated HDF5 archive; confirm every retained dataset value hash matches the source exactly.
Run existing gunw_reader/goff_reader on raw and curated products with identical arguments and compare masks, per-pixel arrays, statistics and exported rasters.
Regenerate current CSV/GeoTIFF outputs from the retained data and compare numeric values and spatial transforms against baseline outputs.
Upload archive and manifest to Drive; verify remote file size and remote MD5/checksum without downloading the whole object again.
Verify cloud object identity/permissions and manifest commit in durable database/storage; only then remove temporary raw HDF5.
For a product with any missing/inventory-unknown current dependency, no archive, checksum or scientific equivalence failure, do not delete the raw file and fail the workflow.

current_behavior: The worker downloads one GOFF product at a time and calls read_goff(layer=layer2, clip_aoi=True, auto_ref=True, deramp=True).

It retains an AOI range-offset lattice, valid-pixel count and scalar mean correlation in memory, then deletes the returned reader object and raw HDF5 before global common-reference/time-series inversion.
A finally cleanup also unlinks remaining raw HDF5 files when an exception occurs, so failed jobs cannot be used to recover the original input unless the product is reacquired.
The result-package validator rejects HDF5 files and the existing Drive uploader reads entire files into RAM, so neither currently provides large curated-source retention.
required_fix_before_production: Insert inventory/archive generation before raw unlink.
Preserve all scoped measurement/QA arrays and metadata listed in this manifest; do not only preserve the AOI range lattice.
Upload with resumable chunks and verify remote byte size/checksum before allowing deletion.
Remove blind finally cleanup or guard it with an explicit verified-archive state; failures retain raw data and mark job retryable/failed.
Persist a stateful manifest with source identity/checksum, archived object IDs/checksums, extractor/science version and verification outcomes.

archive_policy.name: conservative_all_datasets_except_wrapped_with_phase_derivative_v3
archive_policy.default_retained: All HDF5 datasets except the original multidimensional GUNW wrappedInterferogram complex raster, plus a derived sibling wrappedPhase dataset in radians with verified values, metadata and coordinate dimension scales. All scalar/1-D axes, metadata and multidimensional auxiliary grids are retained.
archive_policy.default_excluded: Only multidimensional GUNW datasets whose leaf name is wrappedInterferogram; companion datasets in that group (e.g. coherenceMagnitude, offsets and coordinate axes) remain retained; phase is derived separately.
archive_policy.no_delete: The archiver never deletes raw source and does not upload to Drive.
archive_policy.fail_closed: Reference-containing datasets, non-standard reference-valued attributes, noncanonical links/aliases, ordinary attribute-copy failures, and dimension-scale reconstruction failures stop archive generation; only HDF5 DIMENSION_LIST/REFERENCE_LIST bookkeeping is intentionally rebuilt in the output file. HDF5 user blocks, virtual datasets, and external raw-storage datasets also stop archive generation.
archive_policy.cli_default_excluded: Only the original multidimensional GUNW dataset with leaf name wrappedInterferogram; its wrappedPhase derivative plus companion arrays and every other dataset remain retained.
archive_policy.workflow_pilot_default: include_wrapped=false generates and retains the phase-only derivative; use true when future science requires original complex samples/amplitude and storage budget permits.
